title: ID0412513-DC/Si-D/Nordic [FW 6.1.3] No longer showing idle screen
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
All chargers on the latest fw 6.1.3 are not showing the idle screen anymore. The customers image is no longer showing.
This is regarding all chargers in the nordics on the latest fw 6.1.3.
Root cause: Removed from SW
Solution: Apply screensaver
Update: 14/Mar/2025 - R&D ticket created EVC3-8948

Problem Description
: Not showing IDLE screen after 6.1.3
Troubleshooting
: The official reply from R&D is the following:
"
Yes, the idle screen has been eliminated to have the screen flow more straight forward and less "clicks" have to be done until charging starts. If no screensaver is selected, the default screen is the outlet selection screen."
I would assume that this Idle screen will not return. As such, please align with the customer for the next steps.
Let me know if I can close the ticket.
